name: Patta x Nike Air Max 1 'White'
story_html: The Patta x Nike Air Max 1 ‘White’ reunites the frequent partner brands on an entirely neutral colorway of the classic running shoe. The upper combines light grey mesh with white leather overlays and a matching white leather mudguard, featuring a wavy topline that’s become the design calling card of the Amsterdam-based retailer. Metallic silver accents land on the Patta woven tongue tag, embroidered mini-Swoosh on the lateral forefoot, and Nike Air branding on the heel overlay. A vintage off-white finish is applied to the polyurethane midsole, fitted with visible Air-sole cushioning in the heel.
